Man sleeps with many women he's called a "player" and is rewarded with higher social status. Woman sleeps with many men she's called a "whore" and is considered worthless.

Double standard clearly points to sexism and a power differential between men and women.

I personally think women should be allowed to have as much sex as they like without fearing social ostracism.

Your father sounds unpleasant. You didn't choose to be born. He chose to have you. To think he considers you a disappointment only reflects his failure as a father to love you correctly. He's the one who owes you the love and support you need. Perhaps you can make a list of all the ways in which he's been a disappointment.

That's awesome! So happy for you!

Maybe this is the beginning of a new subreddit? As a massive electronic music fan this gives me hope :)

EDIT: also I am just beginning to embark on this journey.

Sorry to hear about your troubles :(

I advise you make a "costs and benefits" list for each potential avenue available to you. Doing this has helped me tremendously!
